archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Defend the ground and win in the air with efficient flyers and tempo interaction.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Trade resources, draw extra cards, and finish after the opponent has exhausted their threats.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Pressure life totals, borrow opposing creatures, and convert temporary control into permanent value.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Ramp
archetypes.plan: Accelerate and fix mana with Cultivate before deploying creatures larger than the opposing curve.

archetypes.name: Green-White Creatures
archetypes.plan: Curve efficient creatures into larger bodies and use life gain to grow a decisive threat.
